intent: I added two sensors slightly behind the front line (y negative) to improve early detection of sharp turns, addressing the late reaction issue noted in feedback. I increased the sensor size to 0.016 to enhance noise robustness, especially on rougher tracks, as suggested. I also increased the wheel track to 0.16 to improve stability during turns. I expect these changes to reduce line loss events and rms error, improve progress, and enable higher speeds with better control.
rationale: The previous geometry had all sensors slightly forward (y positive), which likely caused late reactions to sharp turns, limiting speed and causing off-track terminations. Adding two sensors behind the front line (y negative) will provide earlier line detection during turns, allowing the controller to react sooner. Increasing sensor size from 0.012 to 0.016 should improve noise robustness, as larger sensors average more surface area, reducing noise impact. Increasing wheel track from 0.14 to 0.16 enhances lateral stability, helping maintain control during turns. These changes address the feedback and should improve line following performance, reducing line loss events and rms error, and increasing progress and completion likelihood. I request measurements of completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, and line_loss_events to verify these hypotheses in the next race.
